claim_wording.becomes_available: The lineage Right held since Book 20 (E1) must show outside training or stand exposed at review (E4, E10).
claim_wording.changes: Makes the lineage's standing conditional, so who may repair becomes a question the Book must answer, and the cohort that never saw the labour (E9) inherits it (inferred).
claim_wording.development: Keeping the channels (d1): the Book 24 review point at which the Special Draw Right's training condition is tested (the review point is agent-proposed, E10).

result.reasoning: E1 establishes that from Book 20 lineage crews carry channel repair under a Special Draw Right. The training condition is not stated in the cited items as established fact. It comes from E10, which is agent_proposed, and from E4, also agent_proposed, which says its stake in the review is an agent inference. E20 repeats E10 in Book 25, so it adds no independent support. The claim's basis_as_stated is inferred, but its load-bearing premise rests on agent-proposed text. E9 supports only that the post-Book 20 generation has never seen the labour, not that it inherits the condition.
result.quote: The Special Draw Right is conditional on training apprentices from outside the lineage.
result.alternative_reading: The offered quote is verbatim from E10 and does carry the premise, so the quote is accurate; the issue is that E10 is agent_proposed. Read against the established record, only the Right and its Book 20 origin (E1) are stated as fact; the training condition is not stated there as established.
result.would_settle: An established record from the Architecture or the author that states the training condition, so that it stops being agent-proposed.
result.creative_room: Possible: the Book 24 review of the Right, the cohort's claim to repair, and the question of who may repair. Keep the Right and its Book 20 origin (E1) as record. Treat the training condition, the review point and the inherited standing as proposals, which leaves the dramatic question open without making the condition canon.
